The '''REV-2K personnel carrier''' was a [[repulsorcraft]] [[transport]] vehicle [[pilot]]ed by an [[astromech droid]] and used to ferry personnel around the [[Santhe Shipyards]]. In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> [[Regional Supervisor]] [[Myn Weaver]] gave [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Hera Syndulla]] a tour of [[Facility 301G]] aboard an REV-2K personnel carrier.<ref name="Toil and Trouble" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The REV-2K personnel carrier first appeared in "[[Part Two: Toil and Trouble]]" of the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] of [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''. It was directed by [[Steph Green]]<ref name="Production Brief">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/kbrxr4mcv75gwbg2spmn6g|text=Ahsoka Production Brief}}</ref> and released on [[August 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-new-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Moves Up to Tuesday, August 22|date=2023-08-18|quote=The two-episode premiere of ''Ahsoka'' will now arrive on Tuesday, August 22 at 6 p.m. PT on Disney+}}</ref>
